contentTypes.addDescription: You can add fields and behaviors after creating it.
contentTypes.addFieldDescription: The field is added to the edit form when you save the type.
contentTypes.addFieldsetDescription: A fieldset groups fields in a tab of the edit form.
contentTypes.addsFieldsUnknown: Its fields show in the form after saving.
contentTypes.behaviorFeaturesHelp: These change how items behave and add no fields, so their order doesn't matter.
contentTypes.behaviorRemovedField: Editors no longer see its field. Stored values are kept.
contentTypes.behaviorRemovedFields: Editors no longer see its {{count}} fields. Stored values are kept.
contentTypes.changeWorkflowUnavailable: Changing the workflow needs a newer backend.
contentTypes.containsEnabled: Contains {{behaviors}}, which the type has. Remove them first.
contentTypes.contentsHelp: Items of this type can contain other items.
contentTypes.defaultPage: Can be used as a folder's default page
contentTypes.defaultPageHelp: Lets editors pick an item of this type as the page a folder shows.
contentTypes.deleteBlocked: Types that still have items can't be deleted. Delete or move their items first:
contentTypes.deleteExplanation: Their fields, behaviors and layout are deleted with them. This can’t be undone.
contentTypes.dependsOnFolder: Visibility then depends on the folder
contentTypes.description: Choose what editors can create, how it is published, and which fields it has.
contentTypes.fieldShortNameHelp: Used in code and the content API, and can't be changed later.
contentTypes.fieldTypesError: The field types couldn't be loaded.
contentTypes.formBehaviorsFixedOrder: This site's content API can't change their order yet: new behaviors go to the end.
contentTypes.formBehaviorsHelp: Their order sets where their fields appear in the edit form: the first one comes first.
contentTypes.formBehaviorsReorderHelp: Drag to change the order. With the keyboard, focus a row and press Alt with the up or down arrow.
contentTypes.formPreviewEstimate: An estimate: after saving, the backend's ordering hints may move some fields.
contentTypes.formPreviewHelp: Hover or focus a behavior to see its fields here.
contentTypes.generalHelp: Shown to editors in the Add menu.
contentTypes.globalAllowHelp: Editors can add it in any folder that doesn't restrict its contents. When off, it can only be added where a folder allows it explicitly.
contentTypes.instead: Instead of {{title}}: switch it on its row.
contentTypes.leaveDescription: Your changes to {{title}} will be lost.
contentTypes.lessVisibleWarning: Some items will be less visible.
contentTypes.lessVisibleWarningHelp: Visitors who can see them now will get a login page instead.
contentTypes.loadError: The content types couldn't be loaded.
contentTypes.lockedFieldsHelp: Locked fields come from behaviors. Their order is set on the behavior, and they disappear when the behavior is turned off on the Behaviors tab.
contentTypes.mapHint: Choose a state in {{workflow}} for each current state. Suggestions keep who can see an item.
contentTypes.mapNothing: {{workflow}} has no states, so there is nothing to map.
contentTypes.moreSettingsLater: Addability, search, default page, comments and versioning settings need a newer version of the content API.
contentTypes.name: Name
contentTypes.nameTaken: A field or fieldset with this short name already exists.
contentTypes.newBehaviorsAtEnd: New behaviors go to the end of the list.
contentTypes.newBehaviorsAtEndMovable: New behaviors go to the end of the list. You can move them afterwards.
contentTypes.noFields: This fieldset has no fields yet.
contentTypes.noFormBehaviors: No behaviors add fields to the form.
contentTypes.notADexterityType: {{title}} isn't a Dexterity type, so it has no fields, behaviors or layout.
contentTypes.noWorkflowDescription: Items take their visibility from their folder.
contentTypes.noWorkflowHelp: Items of this type have no state. They take their visibility from their folder.
contentTypes.otherScopeWorkflows: {{count}} more workflows are only offered for comments.
contentTypes.placefulNote: Folder-level workflow policies still override this.
contentTypes.reorderHelp: Drag custom fields to reorder them. With the keyboard, focus a field's drag handle, press Enter, move with the arrow keys and press Enter again.
contentTypes.reviewNoItems: There are no items to move.
contentTypes.reviewNote: Permissions are updated and items reindexed. On a large site this can take minutes.
contentTypes.reviewNoWorkflow: Items will take their visibility from their folder.
contentTypes.reviewSiteDefault: The site default becomes {{workflow}} instead of {{current}}. The types that follow it change too: {{types}}. Types with a workflow of their own keep it.
contentTypes.reviewUnaffected: {{count}} items under folders with their own workflow policy won't change.
contentTypes.searchableHelp: Turn off for helper types that should never appear in site search.
contentTypes.shortNameHelp: Filled in from the name. Used in URLs and code, and can't be changed later.
contentTypes.shortNameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
contentTypes.shortNameTaken: A type with this short name already exists.
contentTypes.siteDefaultChanged: The site default workflow is now {{workflow}}.
contentTypes.startCopy: A copy of an existing type
contentTypes.startCopyHelp: Copies fields, behaviors, layout and settings.
contentTypes.title: Content types
contentTypes.versioningHelp: Versions let editors compare and revert changes.
contentTypes.versioningManualHelp: Editors save a version when they choose to.
contentTypes.versioningOffHelp: Only the current state is kept.
contentTypes.visibilityRestricted: People with a role on the item
contentTypes.workflowChangeError: The workflow of {{title}} couldn't be changed.
contentTypes.workflowsUnavailable: This site's backend doesn't tell which workflow a type uses yet.
